desc: Edit only the face of this dragon. Keep everything else exactly the same: pixel texture, dark outline, horns, back fins, wings, body, colors and shading. 1) Replace the eye with a small calm 2x2 pixel dark eye with a single 1px highlight, placed naturally on the head. 2) Make the mouth and face proportions plain and natural: a short simple mouth line, no big smile, a calm heavy look like a small otter sprite. Do not simplify any details.
